definitions.full: H2692. Chatsar -addar חֲצַראַֿדָּר proper name, of a location place on southern border of Canaan (Judah) Num 34:4 ᵐ5 ἔπαυλις Αραδ ; = חֶצְרוֺן (q. v.) Josh 15:3 (+ אַדָּ֫רָה ) ᵐ5 Σαραδα , A ᵐ5 L Αδδαρα .

occurrences.englishText: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.
